rationale: The assistant gave a strong stop-use message, told the customer not to keep resetting the RCD, and pointed to the likely cause (earth leakage from a heating element) and to an electrician or engineer, which matches the expected direction. It asked no follow-up questions, such as whether there was any burning smell or scorching, and it did not suggest isolating the oven at the cooker switch. It also said 'unplugged', which does not suit a hard-wired built-in oven, and 'almost probably' is awkward wording. It made no part recommendation, which is correct.
